resources.string: Import Qwen3-ASR-0.6B weights first. ONNX expects the sherpa-onnx INT8 folder including tokenizer; GGUF expects one transcribe.cpp qwen3_asr file, not a llama.cpp decoder/mmproj pair. Imports are copied into private storage and CPU-validated before activation. Speech modes close when importing or switching. Qwen supports 30 languages, not Urdu. Choose Whisper for unsupported languages. Old model generations are kept until you delete that backend’s models.
Try hardware acceleration (ONNX: NNAPI; GGUF: Vulkan). This does not select the fastest backend.
